nuisance_fit.input: source L five standardized-unit branches, original eight-branch geometry unchanged
nuisance_fit.residual: class-conditioned RX or RX-by-day group means minus class mean
nuisance_fit.identity_protection: orthogonalize residuals against between-class mean span before SVD
nuisance_fit.transform: remove selected directions, then unit-normalize; zero residual uses identity

calibration.thresholds: one maximal legal scalar per path/variant/score

advance_rule.fixed_candidate: P1/rxday/relative_mahalanobis only; controls cannot replace it
advance_rule.unknown_RX_scene: diagnostic, not an added scientific gate
advance_rule.failure: NO_PROMOTION; no target reads, no retuning or seed expansion
advance_rule.success: source-only eligibility, not Phase3 completion; freeze before separate small target four-state validation
